decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed development will be In accordance with policy H.6.4. and will complement the original building, harmonise with adjoining properties, maintain the general street scene, and not have an undue adverse impact on any neighbouring properties. Similarly, the relevant provisions of policy B.1.1  relating to all new development are met. It is therefore considered that planning permission should be granted.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension shall not be adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to house.
